# A CAD liability, for money received that is no longer applied to an invoice.
#
# What `--to` is usually given: a payment taken off a record is something you
# may owe back, and this is the shape README names. Opened on its own, with no
# transaction, so any book can be given one.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_settlements_cost_basis_comes_back.py.
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Due to customer
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
